item.title: 5 Bible verses when life asks us to let go of control
item.description: There are seasons of life when the world gradually feels less within our grasp. Tasks once done without thought now require effort or assistance. Decisions are shared. Routines change. For many older men and women, this quiet loss of control can feel unsettling, even deeply painful. Yet this experience, though difficult, is far from new.
